name: Liquid air energy store
effect: cold plus pressure turns gases into liquids
how: When power is cheap, a plant squeezes and chills ordinary air until it turns into a liquid, then keeps it in large vacuum-insulated tanks. Later, letting it warm makes it boil back into a gas about 700 times bigger, and that rush of gas spins a turbine. The stored 'fuel' is just air, so nothing burns and nothing needs mining.
why: Energy stored by squashing air into a liquid, released by letting it boil.
